<!-- Thanks for contributing to qb-ev! -->

## What & why

Describe the change and the motivation. Link any related issue.

## Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Hardening / portability
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Docs / build / CI

## Checklist

- [ ] Public `ev_*` API/ABI preserved (or the change is justified + version-bumped)
- [ ] Builds **warning-clean** under the strict flag set
- [ ] `bash scripts/test-build-matrix.sh native` is green
- [ ] Added/updated a test in `tests/` (for bug fixes / new behaviour)
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] No mass reformatting; style matches surrounding code

## Notes

Behaviour changes, platform/backend specifics, or anything reviewers should know.
